# rwx_group_permissions (Resource)

Manages the complete direct-permission set of an RWX group. Use only one resource per group. Writing this resource replaces all direct assignments, including changes made in the UI; inherited permissions are untouched. Set an empty permissions list to clear direct assignments. Deleting this resource clears direct permissions without deleting the group. Changing `group_id` replaces this resource and clears the old group's direct permissions.

During planning, the provider checks known permission keys, scopes, and grantability against the RWX catalog. It defers checks that require unknown target or resource IDs until those IDs are known. RWX rechecks authority when writing permissions and rejects unauthorized changes and changes to protected groups. Import by the group ID.

## Required permissions

The provider's access token needs `group:manage` on the target group for targeted planning and writes. It must also have authority to grant or remove each changed permission at its requested scope. These token requirements are separate from the assignments in `permissions`. See [permissions](https://www.rwx.com/docs/permissions).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rwx_group" "deployers" {
  name = "Deployers"
}

resource "rwx_vault" "deployments" {
  name = "deployments"
}

resource "rwx_group_permissions" "deployers" {
  group_id = rwx_group.deployers.id
  permissions = [
    { key = "run:read" },
    {
      key         = "vault:unlock"
      resource_id = rwx_vault.deployments.id
    },
  ]
}

data "rwx_group" "auditors" {
  name = "Auditors"
}

resource "rwx_group_permissions" "auditors" {
  group_id = data.rwx_group.auditors.id
  permissions = [
    { key = "run:read" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The stable ID of the group whose direct permissions are managed.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) The complete direct-permission set. Use an empty set to clear direct assignments. Inherited permissions are unchanged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The group ID.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `key` (String) The permission key, such as `run:read` or `vault:manage`. For a scoped assignment, set `resource_id` separately. See [permissions](https://www.rwx.com/docs/permissions) for available keys and supported scopes.

Optional:

- `resource_id` (String) The resource ID for a scoped assignment, such as a vault ID for `vault:manage`. Only keys that support resource scopes accept this attribute. Omit for organization-wide access.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rwx_group_permissions.deployers 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
```
